# Studio Skill: review guide

Status: draft for review; not an installed skill.

## Outcome

An executable Studio guide with a creation checklist and worked example.

Reader: Agents and people starting a Studio

## Procedure

### 1. Name the delivery

Name one product, its reader, and where it will be used.

### 2. Place the Studio

Use the lowest Block, Job or Task that needs its delivery. Keep sNN beside the work.

### 3. Explore alternatives

Keep the main Draw, open choices, and a structured mind map. Preserve previous sketches.

### 4. Connect the work

Link the Jobs and Tasks that make the delivery. Keep working results with their owner.

### 5. Review and hand over

Review the product with a person. Build the clean version, its deck, and its destination mapping.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] The For line names one product and one reader.
- [ ] The main Draw shows alternatives and a delivery destination.
- [ ] Working results and delivery files have separate homes.
- [ ] Acceptance is recorded by a person, never inferred from a build.

## Open design choice

Should creating a Studio require a delivery destination immediately?
